Near $2,127, about flat on the day after a roughly 5% slide into Monday's open.

themes.title: Crypto lags a big tech rally
themes.summary: Bitcoin and Ether barely moved while the Nasdaq rose nearly 3%, a sign of weaker appetite for crypto relative to stocks.

themes.title: Spot ETF outflows weigh
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.28 billion in net outflows last week, the largest since late June, and Ether ETFs lost about $365 million.

themes.title: Early-Monday liquidations
themes.summary: About $803 million in positions were liquidated over four hours as BTC briefly fell to $73,510 and ETH touched $2,060.

themes.title: Ethereum value debate
themes.summary: Vitalik Buterin argued Ethereum's value should rest more on security, decentralization and stability than on fee burns.

themes.title: Sentiment stays fearful
themes.summary: The Fear & Greed Index sits around 29, still in fear territory.
